CHEAP_DATA_NOW: Current SEC plan exhibits describe the issuance/open-market switch. Nuveen official fund page exposes dated NAV/pricing labels. Yahoo public daily JSON on excluded QQQX provides timestamp, timezone and raw OHLC schema. Selected-fund and fixing-date adequacy remains to be proved before economics.
CHEAP_EXPRESSION: Fixed 100-share prospective eligible distribution; compare ideal reinvested shares marked at the exact contractual fixing close with identical cash distribution, then apply frozen incremental frictions. No total-stock-return or dividend-yield inference.
ECONOMIC_SIGNIFICANCE: Conditional contractual issuance benefit is testable as an optimistic incremental ceiling; full investment profitability remains unknown.
FATAL_PROBLEM: Allocation may be delayed, split between market purchases/issuance or inaccessible through a broker. Discount can vanish with NAV/premium or actual sale timing; no assumption that formula value is credited executable wealth.
LESSON: Reinvestment concession is conditional and attaches to the distribution only, not to the whole holding. Preserve API failure and distinguish a schema probe from an economic test.
MECHANISM: A CEF distribution reinvestment plan can issue new shares at the greater of NAV and 95% of market when market >= NAV, giving participants an incremental issuance benefit relative to the same distribution paid in cash. Below NAV, the plan buys in the market and the discount is absent.
NEXT_DECISION: Freeze one prospective 100-share cash-versus-issuance ceiling before T0; no price/NAV or allocation access for selected case until remote claim succeeds.
POWER_LIMITATION: No event selected or economics tested.
UNCERTAINTY: Actual crediting and future same-date NAV not guaranteed by HTML labels.
WHO_PAYS: Issuing fund/nonparticipating shareholders bear dilution when issuance is below market; secondary demand sustaining a premium gives the issued shares their marked value.
WHY_PERSIST: Limited distributions and plan participation, premium/crediting-time risk, broker eligibility, fractional handling, taxes and operations. This is a conditional issuance concession, not free total-position return.
